sentences.zh: 但我打算留下来。

sentences.en: So he's going to stay and watch it all play out.
sentences.zh: 所以他打算留下来，看着这一切如何收场。

sentences.en: This is when Andy tells Aaron that the thing he wanted to tell her is that he's dating someone.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，安迪告诉艾琳，他想告诉她的事是他正在和某人约会。

sentences.en: They've gone on 31 dates.
sentences.zh: 他们已经约会了31次了。

sentences.en: And it's kind of weird because he hasn't let this woman call the office or come by the office to kind of spare Aaron's feelings.
sentences.zh: 这有点奇怪，因为他一直没让这个女人给办公室打电话或来办公室，是为了照顾艾琳的感受。

sentences.en: But now it's getting weird.
sentences.zh: 但现在情况变得有些奇怪了。

sentences.en: And so he needs to tell her.
sentences.zh: 所以他必须告诉她。

sentences.en: I thought Aaron was going to like just slowly die inside.
sentences.zh: 我以为艾琳会当场心碎而死。

sentences.en: I can't believe she even made it out the door.
sentences.zh: 我真不敢相信她竟然还能走出那扇门。

sentences.en: Ellie Kemper crushed it.
sentences.zh: 艾丽·坎伯演得太棒了。

sentences.en: She did.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: She crushed it.
sentences.zh: 她演得太棒了。

sentences.en: I felt her heartache.
sentences.zh: 我感受到了她的心碎。

sentences.en: I felt her awkwardness.
sentences.zh: 我感受到了她的局促。

sentences.en: I felt her embarrassment.
sentences.zh: 我感受到了她的尴尬。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, poor Aaron.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，噢，可怜的亚伦。

sentences.en: The next scene, Pam is being questioned about her ghost sighting again.
sentences.zh: 下一场戏里，帕姆又被问到了关于她看到鬼魂的事。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I love that she called Jim out and was like, hey, how is this any different from you being superstitious about your jersey, you know, and not washing it?
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢她当面质问吉姆，说嘿，这和你迷信你的球衣、不洗球衣有什么区别，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, I want you guys to know the scene was longer and a few people take Pam's side.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想让你们知道，原本那场戏更长一些，而且有几个人是站在帕姆这边的。

sentences.en: It was cut out, but I want you to hear it, please.
sentences.zh: 虽然被剪掉了，但我还是想让你们听听，拜托了。

sentences.en: If ghosts aren't real, how come everyone knows what they look like?
sentences.zh: 如果鬼魂不是真的，那为什么每个人都知道它们长什么样？

sentences.en: It's not like a bunch of people got together and agreed on a lie.
sentences.zh: 这又不是一群人聚在一起商量好撒谎。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: Every culture has this trope.
sentences.zh: 每个文化里都有这种桥段。

sentences.en: Clearly, there's some sort of real phenomenon out there.
sentences.zh: 显然，外面确实存在某种真实的现象。

sentences.en: Oscar, how are you on that side?
sentences.zh: 奥斯卡，你怎么站到那边去了？

sentences.en: This isn't about sides.
sentences.zh: 这不是站队的问题。

sentences.en: This is about me seeing a bluish, gray, old man in the mirror, and then he vanished.
sentences.zh: 这是关于我在镜子里看到了一个蓝灰色调的老人，然后他就消失了。

sentences.en: Pam.
sentences.zh: 帕姆。

sentences.en: This is important.
sentences.zh: 这很重要。

sentences.en: Was he me?
sentences.zh: 那是我吗？

sentences.en: Am I he?
sentences.zh: 我是他吗？

sentences.en: No, Creed.
sentences.zh: 不，克里德。

sentences.en: But that would make more sense.
sentences.zh: 但那样的话反而更说得通。

sentences.en: Luish, gray, old man.
sentences.zh: 蓝灰色调的老人。

sentences.en: And then Creed is amazing.
sentences.zh: 然后克里德的表现太棒了。

sentences.en: Tell me, Pam, was that me?
sentences.zh: 告诉我，帕姆，那是我吗？

sentences.en: But we learn in this scene that Stanley and Oscar are on the same side as Pam, and we know that Meredith is.
sentences.zh: 但我们在这场戏里了解到，斯坦利和奥斯卡是站在帕姆这边的，我们也知道梅雷迪思也是。

sentences.en: So there's more people in the office that believe in ghosts.
sentences.zh: 所以办公室里还有更多人相信鬼魂。

sentences.en: During the scene at 17 minutes and four seconds, on the light fixture behind Jim, there is a fake black crow.
sentences.zh: 在17分04秒的那场戏里，吉姆身后的灯具上有一只假的黑乌鸦。

sentences.en: It is a decoration.
sentences.zh: 那是个装饰品。

sentences.en: However, I will have you know that more than once, more than twice, I don't know why I would just catch that crow in the corner of my eye and it would make me flinch.
sentences.zh: 不过我要告诉你们，不止一次，也不止两次，我不知道为什么我总会用余光瞥见那只乌鸦，然后被它吓一跳。

sentences.en: This decoration really got to be the week we were shooting this, and I was very distracted by it during the scene.
sentences.zh: 拍摄那一周，这个装饰品真的让我很困扰，我在拍戏时被它分了心。

sentences.en: And when I saw it, it was one of those things where I was like, oh, my God, it's the crow.
sentences.zh: 当我看到它时，那种感觉就像是，噢，天哪，是那只乌鸦。

sentences.en: The crow!
sentences.zh: 那只乌鸦！

sentences.en: I remember the crow!
sentences.zh: 我记得那只乌鸦！

sentences.en: It was just like the height of it, the way it was positioned.
sentences.zh: 就是它的高度，还有它摆放的位置。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: That was a personal memory that I've now shared with all of you.
sentences.zh: 那是我的一段个人记忆，现在分享给你们所有人了。

sentences.en: We got a fan question from Carolyn B.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了来自费城的卡罗琳·B发来的粉丝提问，

sentences.en: in Philadelphia who said,
sentences.zh: 她说，

sentences.en: In the spirit of this episode, I have to ask, was there ever a paranormal experience on the set of The Office?
sentences.zh: 秉承本集的主题，我必须问一下，在《办公室》的片场发生过超自然事件吗？

sentences.en: Well, Carolyn, I did not remember one.
sentences.zh: 嗯，卡罗琳，我不记得有发生过。

sentences.en: Angela, I don't know about you.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我不知道你那边怎么样。

sentences.en: I threw it out to The Office text thread.
sentences.zh: 我把这个问题发到了《办公室》的群聊里。

sentences.en: Yes, we have a text thread with the whole cast called The Office Peeps that we are actively on.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们有一个包含所有演员的群聊，叫“办公室伙伴”，我们一直在里面活跃。

sentences.en: It is the sweetest, most wonderful thing.
sentences.zh: 这是最贴心、最美妙的事情了。

sentences.en: I love it when we all pop up on it.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢大家在群里冒泡的时候。

sentences.en: And Jenna put it to the group.
sentences.zh: 然后珍娜把这个问题抛给了大家。

sentences.en: Do you guys remember if we ever had a ghost or paranormal event on the set and everyone has been responding?
sentences.zh: 你们还记得我们片场有没有发生过鬼魂或超自然事件吗？大家都在回复呢。

sentences.en: The whole entire time we have been recording this podcast, our phones have been buzzing
sentences.zh: 在我们录制这期播客的整个过程中，我们的手机一直在响个不停

sentences.en: because everyone is responding and it's getting really silly.
sentences.zh: 因为每个人都在回复，情况变得非常滑稽。

sentences.en: Everyone's like, no, but now people are just kind of making up things.
sentences.zh: 大家都在说，不，但现在人们开始编造一些事情了。

sentences.en: Like Rain said, no, but it's currently haunted by the ghosts of our show.
sentences.zh: 就像雷恩说的，不，但它目前被我们节目的鬼魂缠住了。

sentences.en: And Kate Flannery said, Rain's right.
sentences.zh: 凯特·弗兰纳里说，雷恩是对的。

sentences.en: The office will never die.
sentences.zh: 《办公室》永远不会消亡。

sentences.en: Oscar wants to know if anyone's going to organize an office sleepover at the studio.
sentences.zh: 奥斯卡想知道是否有人打算在摄影棚组织一场办公室留宿活动。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We could spend all night and get to the bottom of this.
sentences.zh: 我们可以通宵达旦，把这件事查个水落石出。

sentences.en: Then he says, unfortunately, I'm busy on that date.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，不幸的是，那天我没空。

sentences.en: The date that hasn't been set.
sentences.zh: 那个还没定下来的日子。

sentences.en: Well, I guess the answer is no.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我想答案是否定的。

sentences.en: None of us remember or experienced a paranormal experience on the set of the office.
sentences.zh: 我们中没有人记得或经历过《办公室》片场的灵异事件。

sentences.en: But I thank you for your question because it has created a very entertaining text thread response.
sentences.zh: 但我感谢你的提问，因为它引发了一连串非常有趣的短信回复。

sentences.en: I have my favorite line of this episode.
sentences.zh: 我有这一集中最喜欢的一句台词。

sentences.en: What is it?
sentences.zh: 是什么？

sentences.en: It's when Robert California notices that Creed is a little nervous around the fake snake.
sentences.zh: 就是罗伯特·加州注意到克里德在假蛇面前有点紧张的时候。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And Robert says, are you scared of snakes?
sentences.zh: 罗伯特说，你怕蛇吗？

sentences.en: And Creed says, you don't live as long as I have without a healthy fear of snakes, Bobby.
sentences.zh: 克里德说，鲍比，像我活这么久的人，不可能不对蛇心存敬畏。

sentences.en: I just love that Creed called him Bobby.
sentences.zh: 我就是喜欢克里德叫他鲍比。

sentences.en: No one else calls him Bobby.
sentences.zh: 没别人叫他鲍比。

sentences.en: Well, thus begins a series of little scenes where whoever Robert is talking to, he's getting them to tell him about his fear.
sentences.zh: 好吧，接下来是一系列小场景，无论罗伯特在和谁说话，他都在诱导对方说出自己的恐惧。

sentences.en: And Daryl is afraid of being buried alive.
sentences.zh: 达里尔害怕被活埋。

sentences.en: And Meredith tells Robert that Jim gives her the creeps.
sentences.zh: 梅雷迪思告诉罗伯特，吉姆让她感到毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: And then this cuts to a Robert California talking head where he just says, what am I up to?
sentences.zh: 然后镜头切到罗伯特·加州的单人访谈，他只是说，我在搞什么名堂？

sentences.en: Bum, bum, bum.
sentences.zh: 咚，咚，咚。

sentences.en: He then launches into a huge, long story.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始讲一个非常长的故事。

sentences.en: A creepy, scary story where he singles out every person practically in the bullpen and plays on their fear in his story.
sentences.zh: 一个令人毛骨悚然的恐怖故事，他在故事里几乎点名了办公区里的每一个人，并利用他们的恐惧大做文章。

sentences.en: Yes, the story has a snake.
sentences.zh: 是的，故事里有蛇。

sentences.en: It has someone being buried alive.
sentences.zh: 有被人活埋的情节。

sentences.en: It has mummies.
sentences.zh: 有木乃伊。

sentences.en: It has someone dying alone.
sentences.zh: 有孤独死去的人。

sentences.en: It has a tall, slim man.
sentences.zh: 有一个又高又瘦的男人。

sentences.en: Jim.
sentences.zh: 吉姆。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it ends so oddly.
sentences.zh: 而且结尾非常奇怪。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And on that fevered night, she rushed to the nursery, threw open the door.
sentences.zh: 在那狂热的夜晚，她冲进育婴室，猛地推开门。

sentences.en: Baby, are you okay?
sentences.zh: 宝贝，你还好吗？

sentences.en: Baby sat up slowly, turned to mother and said, I'm fine, bitch.
sentences.zh: 婴儿慢慢坐起来，转向母亲说，我很好，贱人。

sentences.en: He, like, lowered his voice.
sentences.zh: 他当时压低了嗓音。

sentences.en: It was like, what is happening?
sentences.zh: 简直就像是，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: To which his son laughs hysterically.
sentences.zh: 对此，他的儿子笑得歇斯底里。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Everyone is just speechless.
sentences.zh: 每个人都哑口无言。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And Robert's going to explain what it was all about in his final talking head.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特会在最后的单人访谈中解释这一切的含义。

sentences.en: He says, fear plays an interesting role in our lives.
sentences.zh: 他说，恐惧在我们生活中扮演着有趣的角色。

sentences.en: How dare we let it motivate us?
sentences.zh: 我们怎敢让它来驱使我们？

sentences.en: How dare we let it into our decision making, into our livelihoods, into our relationships?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么敢让它影响我们的决策、我们的生计、我们的关系？

sentences.en: It's funny, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 真有意思，不是吗？

sentences.en: We take a day, a year, to dress up in costume and celebrate fear.
sentences.zh: 我们花一天、一年时间去穿上戏服，庆祝恐惧。

sentences.en: There you have it.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: But this episode is going to end with Bert going over to Toby's desk and firing him.
sentences.zh: 但这一集结尾会是伯特走到托比的办公桌前解雇他。

sentences.en: He says, I'm the CEO's son, and you're fired.
sentences.zh: 他说，我是CEO的儿子，你被解雇了。

sentences.en: So mean.
sentences.zh: 太刻薄了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Dwight is pranking Toby.
sentences.zh: 德怀特在恶搞托比。

sentences.en: He's, like, laughing silently over the partition.
sentences.zh: 他就像是在隔板那边无声地大笑。

sentences.en: So mean.
sentences.zh: 太刻薄了。

sentences.en: At 21 minutes and 4 seconds, I noticed two things in Toby's nook.
sentences.zh: 在21分04秒时，我注意到了托比的小隔间里有两件事。

sentences.en: One good and one, huh?
sentences.zh: 一件好的，还有一件……嗯？

sentences.en: The good one is that there are a bunch of new photos of Toby's daughter on the wall.
sentences.zh: 好的那件是墙上多了很多托比女儿的新照片。

sentences.en: I love this detail.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个细节。

sentences.en: I love how our desks changed with us and with the passage of time.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我们的办公桌随着我们和时间的流逝而发生变化。

sentences.en: You know, he still has his little puppy dog thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他还有那个小狗摆件。

sentences.en: He has a lot of things that are the same, but all the pictures on the wall.
sentences.zh: 他有很多东西都没变，但墙上的照片全换了。

sentences.en: His daughter is older.
sentences.zh: 他女儿长大了。

sentences.en: You know, Toby's daughter was played by one of our crew members' daughters,
sentences.zh: 你知道，托比的女儿是由我们剧组人员的女儿扮演的，

sentences.en: and that crew member would bring in updated photos for Toby's nook.
sentences.zh: 那位剧组人员会带更新的照片来装饰托比的小隔间。

sentences.en: So new pictures.
sentences.zh: 所以是新照片。

sentences.en: But also, that brings me to Huh?
sentences.zh: 但这也让我想到了那个“嗯？”

sentences.en: Which is on his desk, he has a mug with all of his pens and pencils in it,
sentences.zh: 就是在他桌上，他有一个放着所有钢笔和铅笔的杯子，

sentences.en: but it's a yellow NBC Peacock mug.
sentences.zh: 但那是一个黄色的NBC孔雀台标杯子。

sentences.en: Whoopsies.
sentences.zh: 哎呀。

sentences.en: Huh?
sentences.zh: 嗯？

sentences.en: What's that about?
sentences.zh: 那是怎么回事？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Well, that was spooked, lady.
sentences.zh: 好吧，刚才真是吓人，女士。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I think what I learned is there's nothing scarier than Robert California zeroing in on you.
sentences.zh: 我想我学到的是，没有什么比罗伯特·加利福尼亚盯着你看更可怕的了。

sentences.en: I think you're right.
sentences.zh: 我想你是对的。

sentences.en: I think you're right.
sentences.zh: 我想你是对的。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, everyone, for listening.
sentences.zh: 好了，谢谢大家的收听。

sentences.en: Thank you to Steve Burgess and the Office Peeps text thread for getting back to us.
sentences.zh: 感谢史蒂夫·伯吉斯和“办公室伙伴”短信群组回复我们。

sentences.en: And thanks to you guys for sending in your questions and comments.
sentences.zh: 也感谢你们发来问题和评论。

sentences.en: We just love them so much.
sentences.zh: 我们真的非常喜欢。

sentences.en: And happy summer, everybody.
sentences.zh: 祝大家夏天快乐。

sentences.en: We're going to take two weeks off.
sentences.zh: 我们要休息两周。

sentences.en: My birthday is coming up.
sentences.zh: 我的生日快到了。

sentences.en: Angela, once again, we will not be working on your birthday.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，再说一次，你生日那天我们不会工作的。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: We won't be working on my birthday.
sentences.zh: 我生日那天我们不会工作的。

sentences.en: That's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: I'll eat cake for everybody.
sentences.zh: 我会替大家吃蛋糕的。

sentences.en: Well, we'll see you in two weeks, everyone.
sentences.zh: 好吧，两周后见，各位。

sentences.en: Love you.
sentences.zh: 爱你们。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。
